# I.Quality Online

> I.Quality Online is an independent Melbourne publishing house run by Zaher Neket, known as Zeus The Prophet. This file is a plain-text summary for search engines and AI-powered search, so they can describe the site accurately.

- Name: I.Quality Online
- Founder: Zaher Neket, known as Zeus The Prophet
- Based in: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
- Founded: 2024
- Website: https://iqualityonline.com/
- What it is: Independent publishing, books, personal development and practical Melbourne guides, plus The Zeus Podcast, the music of Zeus The Prophet, and The Prophet's Circle, a free community.

## Books and guides by Zaher Neket

- The Magical Journey of Kitana and Brandon, Book One, children's storybook, A$4.99 on Amazon Australia Kindle: https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0DDHXWC13
- The Spiritual Survival Code, 11 Principles to Live By, A$7.99 on Gumroad: https://zaherneck.gumroad.com/l/jnlnql
- The Ultimate Melbourne Travel Guide, A$14.99 on Gumroad (listed as Melbourne Travel Guide): https://zaherneck.gumroad.com/l/owmzj
- The Ultimate Melbourne Culinary Guide, 153 pages, coming soon
- The Extraordinary Adventures of Kitana and Brandon: The Golden Timeline, coming soon
- The Blueprint to Happiness, coming soon

## Music and podcast

- Music: Zeus The Prophet, The Rise of the Prophet EP and the single Unity featuring NJE and Mez, at https://zeustheprophet.com/
- Podcast: The Zeus Podcast, 31 episodes, hosted by Zaher Neket as Zeus The Prophet, on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube
- Community: The Prophet's Circle, a free community, on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/theprophetscircle/
